lines.en: What did the man in this story do?
lines.cn: 这个故事里的男人做了什么？

lines.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport,
lines.cn: 当一架从伦敦起飞的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，

lines.en: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
lines.cn: 工人们开始卸下许多装有衣物的木箱。

lines.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
lines.cn: 没有人能够解释为什么其中一个箱子会异常地重。

lines.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
lines.cn: 突然，其中一个工人想到应该打开那个箱子。

lines.en: He was astonished at what he found.
lines.cn: 他对自己的发现感到非常惊讶。

lines.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
lines.cn: 一个男人躺在箱子里，而那个箱子放在一堆羊毛制品的上面。

lines.en: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
lines.cn: 他发现自己被发现了，惊讶得连逃跑的念头都没有。

lines.en: the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
lines.cn: 那名男子承认在飞机离开伦敦之前躲在了那个箱子里。

lines.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip,
lines.cn: 他经历了一段漫长而令人不适的旅程。

lines.en: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
lines.cn: 因为他已经被关在那个木箱里超过十八个小时了。

lines.en: The man was ordered to pay ￡3, 500 for the cost of the trip.
lines.cn: 这名男子被要求支付3,500英镑作为旅行的费用。

lines.en: The normal price of a ticket is ￡2, 000!
lines.cn: 而一张普通票的价格仅为2,000英镑！

words.meaning: 关在(一个狭小的空间里)
